simple.meaning: אֶשְׁכָּר (ʼeshkâr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a gratuity.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Psalms 72:10. The surrounding context includes kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶשְׁכָּר (H814) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
